question: Did 13VR inadvertently downgrade the previously authenticated public nine-PDF acquisition by citing 13VB but omitting intervening 13VC, and what exactly can be corrected without creating a spurious target witness?

evidence_crosscheck.meaning: Correct for 13VB's own acquisition date, superseded by 13VC for public series bytes.

evidence_crosscheck.source_attribution: 國家圖書館 / 徐安明萬曆27年刻本

identified_record_defect.exact_overstatement: 13VR's statement that 'nine backup file contents remain unverified' and its reliance only on 13VB are stale as at the repository's 13VC evidence.
identified_record_defect.corrected_scope: The complete named nine-PDF public backup series was already downloaded and file-SHA-256 recorded in 13VC; its PDF page counts and 18 selected source-native start/end headings were checked, supporting exclusion of juan45 from that defined public series. The Shidian reader was separately scoped in 13VR.
identified_record_defect.preserved_true_limit: The NLC first-party item detail, any additional unlisted holding/juan beyond this series, exact physical-copy/impression/plate relationships, and byte-level identity between Shidian reader pages and Commons PDFs were not resolved.
identified_record_defect.pagination_firewall: The 515 PDF pages and 975 Shidian reader pages are not interchangeable page-address spaces. Matching title/accession/volume coverage does not authorize equal page-to-page image hashes or an independent-witness count.
identified_record_defect.prior_reports_preserved: 13VB, 13VC and 13VR remain in place with their original date-scoped observations; this append-only document is the governing reconciliation.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Same accession and matching volume coverage prove neither Shidian-page-to-PDF byte identity nor an independent physical copy or printing plate.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Whether the Shidian reader and nine Commons PDFs are derivatives of the exact same scanned physical object is not established by a per-leaf cross-hash.
Whether any independently authenticated additional NLC holding has juan45 remains open.

next_action: Do not revisit the already-excluded nine Commons backup PDFs or the specific Shidian reader merely because 13VR omitted 13VC; reopen these only upon genuinely new item/range evidence. Prioritize Zhejiang Library 善002648 juan45 survival, independent original Xu-An L132 glyph and 疾 construction/radix/carry, alongside National Museum, NCL06270, SYSU and verified facsimile/microfilm targets.
